description: Abstract content-only overlay for an old electronic display: a small flat dark-slate rectangular screen area centered inside 32x24, two thin broken desaturated gray horizontal scan bars and a few isolated pixel glitches. Sharp rectangular footprint, transparent outside. No monitor bezel, hardware, writing, numbers, glow or drawn lighting. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 32x24 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
